_comment: Quarantined / vaulted entries and categories held out of world-data.json so players cannot see or access them in the live O-Codex.

vaulted_categories.label: Divions
vaulted_categories.description: Motes of Divine power. Some are strewn about the world, others are gifted to those pursuing fierce aspirations; All of them will intertwine themselves with fate.

vaulted_entries.name: Rennick Corvin
vaulted_entries.summary: Droland Palace's head medical researcher, an astute scientist whose interest in eschatons and aether runs deeper than he admits.
vaulted_entries.description: Rennick Corvin is an elven scientist at Droland Palace and the Head Researcher of its Medical Branch. At first glance he comes across as purely intellectual, measured, and highly analytical, but that academic demeanor conceals someone far more socially perceptive than he lets on. Rennick reads rooms well, understands people quickly, and often seems to know more about a conversation's shape than he should. He has recently turned much of his attention toward eschatons and the strange properties of aether, and during the party's venture into the Droland Waterways, he also seemed strangely familiar with one of the gutter lords, suggesting roots or connections he has not explained. Unknown to most, he possesses Revis, the Eschaton of Diffusion and Time.

details.Role: Head Researcher of the Medical Branch in Droland Palace
details.Hidden Strength: Exceptionally skilled at reading people and social situations
details.Current Focus: Researching eschatons and aether through a medical and scientific lens
details.Eschaton: Possesses Revis, Eschaton of Diffusion and Time

vaulted_entries.name: Aetherwell
vaulted_entries.summary: A mysterious force tied to the creation of Manifests, seemingly shaped in part by danger, isolation, and the headspace of nearby minds.
vaulted_entries.description: The Aetherwell is the force currently believed to create Manifests, though not in any simple or predictable way. Notes recovered from a Canthian collection suggest that its effects are partly random, but that nearby conscious beings, their significance, and their headspace can influence what form a Manifest takes. The same notes also suggest that isolation and dangerous locations are especially conducive to what they call the Aetherwell Effect. If true, then powerful items may not merely appear where danger already exists; they may be shaped by the thoughts, stakes, and pressure surrounding those places.

details.Influences: Context, significance, and the headspace of nearby conscious entities

vaulted_entries.name: Knacks
vaulted_entries.summary: Unusual talents that some people are simply born with, or else develop in ways that feel abnormal even by magical standards.
vaulted_entries.description: Knacks are odd talents that appear in certain people without following the usual paths of study, training, or inherited magical discipline. Some seem to be born with them outright, while others develop them in ways that feel abrupt, unnatural, or difficult to explain. However they emerge, Knacks stand apart from ordinary learned magic as abilities that feel personal, instinctive, and often unsettlingly specific.

details.What They Are: Unusual personal abilities outside ordinary magical training
details.How They Appear: Either innate from birth or developed in abnormal ways

vaulted_entries.name: Black Shards
vaulted_entries.summary: Strange dark fragments dispensed by ancient sites, used by the Spire to enable Traversal.
vaulted_entries.description: Black Shards are unusual objects dispensed by certain ancient settlements and trial sites. They appear to serve as a kind of destination key, allowing the Spire to recognize and connect to the place that issued them. Once brought back and properly integrated, a shard can enable Traversal, letting the party move there instantly through the Spire rather than by road, sea, or air. Their exact makeup remains strange even by magical standards, and they feel less like treasure than pieces of an older system still waiting to be reactivated.

details.Source: Dispensed by certain ancient settlements or trial sites
details.Importance: Acts as a destination key for instant movement

vaulted_entries.name: Channeling
vaulted_entries.summary: A Spire-unlocked form of Divion assignment that lets the party channel divine power through certain people they have met.
vaulted_entries.description: Channeling is the practical name for the Divion assignment capability unlocked through Perifreul. It allows party members to tap into the divine power of certain people they have encountered, effectively channeling the blessings those individuals have already received. Though the deeper rules are still uncertain, Channeling appears to be the bridge that lets the party borrow divine force without needing to be the original bearers of those blessings.

details.What It Does: Lets the party channel the divine powers of people they have met
details.Current Understanding: A way to borrow divine blessings through the Spire
